settings.paymentNote: After you place your order we'll email you a secure payment link within 24 hours. Your items are held for you until then.
settings.about:
Grail House is a curated resale shop for people who care about quality. We hunt down standout sneakers, outerwear and accessories, inspect every single piece by hand, and only list what we'd be proud to own ourselves.

Resale keeps great pieces in circulation and out of landfill. Every purchase gives a well-made item a second life.
settings.sellText: Have something special? We buy and consign sneakers, outerwear, bags and accessories in great condition. Send us a few photos and we'll reply with an offer within 48 hours.

faq.a: Every piece is inspected by hand before it is listed. We check materials, stitching, labels and serial details. If anything is ever not as described, you get a full refund.

faq.q: What do the condition grades mean?
faq.a: New with tags: never worn, original tags. New: never worn. Like new: worn once or twice with no visible wear. Excellent: light signs of wear. Very good: some visible wear, shown in photos. Vintage: older piece with natural aging.
Place your order and we'll email you a secure payment link within 24 hours. Your items are reserved for you until then.
Orders ship within 2 business days. Standard delivery takes 3–7 days and express takes 1–3 days.
Yes. Returns are accepted within 14 days of delivery as long as the item is unworn and in the condition it arrived.

policies.shipping: Orders are packed by hand and ship within 2 business days. Standard shipping takes 3–7 business days. Express shipping takes 1–3 business days. Shipping is free on orders over the amount shown at checkout. You'll receive a tracking number by email as soon as your order ships.
policies.returns: You can return any item within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, with all original tags and packaging. Email us to start a return and we'll send instructions. Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5 business days of us receiving the item.
policies.privacy: We only collect the information needed to process your order: your name, email and shipping address. We never sell or share your information. Your bag and saved items are stored only on your own device.
policies.terms: All items are pre-owned or new resale items unless stated otherwise. Prices and availability can change without notice. By placing an order you agree to pay the total shown at checkout. We reserve the right to cancel orders if an item becomes unavailable, with a full refund.
